name: A Song for You
source:
Shizuna is just a girl who wishes to become one thing - a famous pop idol! And for that reason she has moved from her small hometown to the big city, working her way up by working in an idol-themed maid café as well as balancing college life. Of course, her life as an up and coming idol hasn’t been perfect - some café patrons like Akio are a bit of a nuisance, and dealing with her tutor Chihaya is annoying - but she’s willing to deal with them for her dream. But what about Misaki, the boy she bumps into while playing in the arcade? What could he, and the two other boys have in store for Shizuna’s future?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=10826]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
translation:
靜奈只有一個夢想，就是成為知名偶像歌手！為此她從家鄉小鎮搬到了大城市，在偶像主題女僕咖啡廳打工，同時兼顧大學生活。當然，她作為新晉偶像的生活並不完美——像秋雄這樣的一些常客有點煩人，應付家教千早也很讓人惱火——但為了夢想她願意忍受。但是，那個在電玩遊樂場裡撞到的男孩岬呢？他和另外兩個男孩會給靜奈的未來帶來什麼？

［來自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=10826]Lemma Soft forums[/url]］
